scope: All 182 residual zero-ending genitive-plural forms of soft-stem verbal nouns in the live v019 Latin sources: 170 in papers 1-43, five in book 44, and seven in paper 45.
choice: Repair each audited verbal-noun genitive plural from -anj/-enj to the regular -anij/-enij form while preserving its lexical stem, case function, capitalization, sentence, and mathematical content.
motivation: Every site is a genitive plural. The zero-ending forms conflict with the accepted official soft-stem paradigm and with the edition's already established repair of prědstavjenj to prědstavjenij. Adding the required i removes a systemic morphology defect without changing meaning or syntax.
alternatives_rejected: Retain the zero-ending forms as free variants: this leaves a systematic noncanonical paradigm across 39 verbal-noun types.
Blindly rewrite every word ending in -enj: that would corrupt lexical masculine nouns such as stepenj, stupenj, and korenj.
Recast the surrounding sentences: unnecessary because the defect is purely inflectional and has an exact morphology-preserving repair.

official_noun_grammar.relevance: Soft-stem and epenthetic genitive-plural rules require the -nij realization for verbal nouns in -nje.

official_generator_precedent.finding: The official morphology generator maps the -nj verbal-noun stem to -nij in the genitive plural; that accepted decision repaired prědstavjenj to prědstavjenij.

context_review.finding: All 182 exact locators were inspected as genitive plural in their containing sentence; no heading, metadata, macro identifier, protected foreign span, or comment is included.

validation.coverage: 182/182 source sites mapped by exact case-sensitive 39-form histogram
validation.residue: zero mapped zero-ending verbal-noun genitive-plural forms remain
validation.protected_lexical_nouns: 79 stepenj, 30 stupenj, and 10 korenj occurrences remain byte-exact
validation.protected_spans: TeX comments and foreign-language arguments unchanged
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
